description: Image Description: The image displays a computer screen with multiple overlapping windows, primarily showing technical system error messages and debugging information. The dominant portion of the screen features a black terminal-like window filled with white text detailing a system failure. The error message includes a code "00000007 (Corrupt skip lists)" and provides extensive technical details such as CPU crash info, exception state, PC, MSR, DRR, and DSISR values. There is a backtrace listing memory addresses
